text: (1)A valid ordinary passport (valid for more than one year; applicants in China must also submit a valid residence permit page).(2)Notarized highest academic degree certificate (scanned original and translation).If the applicant is currently a student, a Certificate of Enrollment issued by the school specifying the expected graduation date must be submitted.Certificates obtained overseas must be notarized; certificates obtained within China require only a scanned copy.(3)Scanned copies of transcripts from the previous academic stage and their translations.(4)Study and Research Plan for master’s applicants (at least 1,000 words), including: Introduction, Research Questions, Literature Review, Research Methods, Expected Conclusions, and References.(5)Two academic recommendation letters from professors or associate professors for master’s applicants (written in Chinese or English).(6)Foreigner Physical Examination Form (fully completed and valid within 6 months) (Blank form attached as Annex ).(7)Valid Certificate of No Criminal Record issued by the local public security authority (normally within 6 months prior to the application submission date).(8)Language proficiency certificates:Chinese-taught programs: HSK certificate.English-taught programs: TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo certificates (Exemptions apply as noted above).(9)Academic achievements, cultural and sports competition certificates (if available).
